create.name: Danielle Van de Velde
create.bio:
Danielle Van de Velde, who goes by Dani, is a meditation teacher, Reiki master and medium living in Singapore with her family. Before teaching full time she worked for some twenty years in financial services and property, in roles spanning communications, capital raising and HR, across Australia, Europe and the United States, while quietly pursuing meditation and esoteric study on the side. She qualified as a meditation teacher with Louise Gilmore at the Awareness Institute in Sydney, has practised Satyananda and hatha yoga for over two decades, trained in the Usui Reiki lineage, and has since studied mediumship at Arthur Findlay College in England and Jungian thought at the Centre for Applied Jungian Studies.

Her teaching borrows from several traditions, yoga, shamanic journeying and Buddhist heart practices among them, and is aimed at helping people understand their own energy and shift from reacting to life towards meeting it creatively. In Singapore she leads Friday sunrise meditations in parks and on the beach, with the takings given to a monthly charity, as well as Reiki attunement weekends and seasonal ritual workshops; her online courses, circles and masterclasses sit inside her Spirited Living membership. She is the author of Spirited (Balboa Press, 2022), hosts The Modern Crone podcast and records guided meditations for Insight Timer.

books.title: Spirited: A Guide to Your Innate Spiritual Design to Transform Your Life
books.author: Danielle Van de Velde
books.description: Her 2022 book sets out how she understands the spiritual self, the energy body and the way life unfolds, and offers meditation and energy practices to go with each part. It treats meditation as a deliberate habit for moving from reactive patterns into a more open and creative way of living.

courses.title: The Spirited Living Membership
courses.description: Her online membership, which holds her self-paced meditation courses such as Discovery and Heart Light, her psychic development circles, live masterclasses and group coaching. Members join a community of fellow practitioners and can take part at their own pace.

courses.title: Dawn Dreaming Outdoor Charity Meditations
courses.description: An hour of sunrise practice on Friday mornings at outdoor spots around Singapore such as Fort Canning, East Coast Beach and the Botanic Gardens, with sharing, breathwork and simple energy exercises. Beginners are welcome, and the fees go to a monthly charity.

courses.title: Traditional Usui Reiki Level 2 Attunements
courses.description: A small-group, two-day workshop in Singapore covering the second-degree Usui Reiki symbols, practices and three attunements. After it, and a period of self-practice, students can offer Reiki to others as certified practitioners.

courses.title: Sun Magic Workshop: The Sun Wheel of Becoming
courses.description: A two-hour gathering in Singapore themed on Helios, using story, ritual and intuitive exercises, in which each person makes their own Sun Wheel to reflect on what is growing in their life. Net proceeds after venue costs go to charity.

courses.title: The Language of the Sleeping Soul
courses.description: A three-hour online workshop on dreams as a place where guides and loved ones in spirit may make contact, and on reading the symbols and impressions they leave. Held live on Zoom.

courses.title: Spirited Masterclass Series: The Year of the Fire Horse in Review with Dani
courses.description: An evening masterclass on Zoom in which she looks back over the energies and themes of the Year of the Fire Horse. Included free for Spirited Living members.

free_resources.title: Spirit Guide Journey
free_resources.description: A guided journey to the Upper World in the shamanic manner, meant to help you meet the spirit guide most present in your life now. It can be repeated to deepen that contact.

free_resources.title: Ho'oponopono
free_resources.description: A guided practice built on the Hawaiian prayer of forgiveness, taking responsibility for past words or actions and asking for forgiveness with an open heart.

sprint.held: Held (4 Nov 2026): daniellevandevelde.com serves her photos to curl's default identity but closes the connection for the ingest's honest user agent (SpiritpediaIngest/1.0), as with Ani Rinchen Khandro.
